limitations: Scores are provisional browser scores on a 0–10 scale; null denotes genuinely inapplicable dimensions.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F with inapplicable dimensions excluded.
This evaluation uses the supplied screenshots, chronological still filmstrips and runtime-evidence narrative; no video was watched or browser checks independently rerun.
Corresponding transition, normal-text, enlarged-text and repeated fixture variants are grouped under their represented task state.
Runtime claims are attributed to the supplied evidence, including layout, contrast, focus restoration, persistence, reduced motion and isolated timing results.
The filmstrips establish sampled visual continuity, not frame rate; the reported isolated timing measurements provide the performance evidence.
Visible focus and pressed treatments for wood buttons and parchment choices remain weak despite other reported keyboard checks.
Some screenshots are intentionally scrolled or constrained; offscreen content alone is not treated as unreachable, especially where runtime reachability is reported.
No confirmed hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; weak visible focus requires attention but does not by itself prove an inaccessible primary action.
Independent painted layers, parallax and physically accurate lighting cannot be established from these images; visible contact shadows, occlusion and transition changes were assessed directly.

Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, actual OS sharing, native performance and connected social-service behavior remain deferred and unverified, without deductions solely for that boundary.
Billing and sharing interfaces include simulations; sample forecasts and synthetic layout text establish neither model quality nor predictive accuracy.
The authorized browser threshold is not met: several screens and components remain below A >= 9 or F >= 9, especially typography, scene continuity, room-route clarity and visible control states.
topFixes: Make wood-button and parchment-choice focus and pressed states as conspicuous as the demonstrated settings-switch focus outline.
Stabilize orb, table and control positions during Home push/pull transitions; avoid destination content visibly settling into a different layout after appearing.
Retain centered text while shortening explanation groups, adding concise subheads and controlling enlarged heading spacing.
Add functional subtitles to Shelf, Hearth and Cabinet so their History, Circles and Plans destinations are predictable.
Improve physical grounding with consistent edge thickness, contact shadows and lighting on floating paper, wood panels and non-Home orbs.
Clarify overflowing input and fixed-footer boundaries, and reduce enlarged form/card spacing so important next actions are easier to discover.
